roadmap.note: Repository, pinned orchestration skill, policy scanners, pipeline, license manifest.
Eleven stage deterministic pipeline with stage status and invariants.
Manual, automatic, hybrid, disabled providers with radius randomization and seeds.
IANA based offsets and daylight saving plus five separated locale surfaces.
Codec, system transport with TCP retry, HTTPS and TLS clients tested against local servers.
Versioning, migration, integrity, import, export, rollback.
Coarse proposals with confidence, notes and manual override transparency.
Consistency findings, redaction levels, structured events.
Requires the engine toolchain which is absent in the measured environment.
Scaffold validated by twenty checks; assembly requires Android SDK and Gradle.
Threat model, boundaries and scanners complete; signing pipeline planned with packaging.
Six vector assets plus raster legibility validation from 16 to 1024 pixels.
